SELECT o.order_id, SUM(i.quantity * i.unit_price) AS line_value FROM orders_dist AS o JOIN order_items_dist AS i ON i.customer_id = o.customer_id AND i.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.customer_id = 1 GROUP BY o.order_id

SELECT o.customer_id,SUM(i.quantity*i.unit_price) AS line_value FROM orders o JOIN order_items i USING(order_id) WHERE o.status='paid' AND o.placed_at>=timestamptz '2026-10-01 00:00+00' AND o.placed_at<timestamptz '2026-11-01 00:00+00' GROUP BY o.customer_id ORDER BY line_value DESC,o.customer_id

WITH generated AS (SELECT CASE WHEN n%10<7 THEN 1001 ELSE 1002+(17*n+20261025)%999 END AS customer_id FROM generate_series(0,119999) n) SELECT count(*) AS total,count(*) FILTER(WHERE customer_id=1001) AS hot FROM generated
